name: codeforge
description: CodeForge — a fast, private, browser-based code editor. The editor, file explorer, and project management are a pure static frontend (deploy public/ or dist/ anywhere, no backend required). Running it locally (`npm run dev` or `npm run serve:simple`) additionally enables a real, local-only Terminal panel backed by an actual shell — see server/terminal-backend.js and README.md. Vite is used only as a dev server and static-copy build tool — there's nothing to bundle, since Monaco and the service worker both need stable, unhashed file paths.
